verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents many UI-only features of the Gemini app, including Gems, Notebooks, scheduled actions, Connected Apps, Deep Research, image editing and GitHub import. Nothing shows any of them are reachable programmatically. The runtime probe found the consumer app exposes no agent-docs or API/MCP discovery surface, and it notes the developer API is a separate product, so there is no evidence of UI-to-API parity.
